models.name: SOFA
models.population: Adults in ICU (also used outside ICU)
models.predicts: Degree of organ dysfunction; an acute rise of 2 or more points defines sepsis (Sepsis-3).
models.scoring: Sum of the worst value for each organ system in 24 h. Range 0–24. Catecholamine doses in µg/kg/min given for at least 1 h.

cutoffs.means: Sepsis in a patient with suspected infection (Sepsis-3); about 10% in-hospital mortality
Assumed 0 if no known pre-existing organ dysfunction

models.name: SOFA-2
models.predicts: Organ dysfunction severity, updated for contemporary organ support (high-flow oxygen, NIV, ECMO, RRT, delirium drugs).

head: Organ system
rows: ≤75 with advanced ventilatory support, or ECMO
Noradrenaline + adrenaline ≤0.2 µg/kg/min, or any other vasopressor/inotrope
Noradrenaline + adrenaline >0.2–0.4, or ≤0.2 with another agent
Noradrenaline + adrenaline >0.4, or >0.2–0.4 with another agent, or mechanical support
>3.5, or UO <0.3 mL/kg/h ≥24 h, or anuria ≥12 h
Receiving or meets criteria for RRT

models.scoring: Sum of the worst value per organ system in 24 h; range 0–24. SpO2/FiO2 may replace PaO2/FiO2 when unavailable and SpO2 <98% (cut-offs >300, ≤300, ≤250, ≤200 with support, ≤120 with support or ECMO). Without advanced respiratory support the respiratory score is capped at 2. Missing day-1 values score 0.

cutoffs.means: Sepsis-3 threshold (≥2-point rise) not yet formally re-derived for SOFA-2
